parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

- Maximum value: **100**.

- Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The status of the MPS queues to search for. If you leave this parameter empty, all MPS queues are searched by default.

- **All**: All MPS queues.

- **Active**: The MPS queue is active.

- **Paused**: The MPS queue is paused.

- Default value: **All**.
